title: A great way to relax!
text: The massage was wonderful! The therapist was excellent and knowledgeable. It was a great experience!
author: 483lilliamp

title: Great Massage
text: Excellent massage. Very Caring and professional. She asked what I wanted her to concentrate on. Did an excellent job.
author: Kenneth_V

title: An accessible and necessary luxury
text:
I have been going to Más Vital for many years, looking for a restorative bubble, both physically and mentally, and I have always left satisfied.
I went again this week, and again Roberto “has put his hands together”, but, I don't know why, this time it has been especially gratifying. I don't know if it was the calm and slow pace that he gave to the session, the deeper and more incisive work on the most damaged parts (those lumbar...) or the wise combination of techniques and stretching, but the fact is that I came out like new.
I highly recommend it, it is a luxury that is as accessible as it
author: Javier S

title: Excellent Service and Professional Care
text:
As always a very professional and attentive Service.
The staff adapts to my needs, paying special attention to the knots in the neck and back.
Highly recommended both for relaxing and for therapeutic reasons.
I hadn’t been there for more than two years and I have to say that customer service remains impeccable.
author: M4085HIenriqueg

title: Perfect 🤩
text: A massage worthy of Thai massages, perfection to the maximum, rosa knew how to detect all the knots and made them disappear with her expert hands. We leave relaxed, it was magical, I recommend 1000 times!
author: Imen B

title: Beautiful and Clean and Top Rated Massage
text: We recently moved to Granada and with Covid I had not had a massage for a long time. My husband booked an 80-minute massage for me at MasVital for my birthday and I was so pleased and impressed with the service. They took many precautions for Covid including cleaning after every use - the place was spotless and I could see them cleaning every area while waiting. They had open windows and fans for circulation and breathable masks for when I was face up during the massage. Roberto was an excellent masseuse. I have had many massages and it was one of the best. author: ashSpeeR4

title: Plantar reflexology
text: I really enjoyed the Quality Service from Welcoming to Handling: very professional masseuse who started to untie the upper body tensions before the reflexology itself; and that's a plus! I left the living room full of energy, invigorated! I recommend without hesitation and will return when I return to Granada. Thank you very much.
author: Pronight1971

title: Perfect massage
text: I was in Granada for road biking and by chance found this place. The massage was incredible! It helped me recover from the tension and pain I had from possibly a little too much road biking with a little too less stretching in between. I first got a 10 minutes massage at a Japanese festival as advertisement for Shiatsu, and then made an appointment for a full hour appointment. I would go there any time again, and can only recommend it to everyone. They offer a variety of techniques, and are very perceptive of individual problems and painpoints. The price is really fair and worth every cent. Al
author: Maral H

title: Transcendental massage.
text: The best massage and relaxation site discovered, is not a place to use where you are merely a client. You come out refreshed of mind body and spirit.
author: Agetro69

title: Welcome Massage
text: Moises is a skilled masseur, firm pressure and good knowledge of the body’s structure. The location is modest and clean. After 3 weeks traveling, including a 6-day bike tour and lots of walking, I was ready for a thorough massage. Moises delivered.
author: Deiso
